title: CX Business Analyst
description: We are seeking a  Business Insights Analyst based in India (aligned to US Eastern hours) to join the Customer Value Strategy & Enablement team, reporting to the Senior Manager. This individual will play a critical role in delivering data-driven insights, executive-ready reporting, and performance analytics that help Product Operations and cross-functional teams optimize operations, elevate the customer experience, and drive measurable value.   This position will focus on reporting and analytics (especially Sigma), KPI development, and operational performance tracking. This role partners closely with the Sr. Manager of Customer Value Strategy & Enablement to enable data-backed decision-making, highlight risks and opportunities, and translate analytics into actionable strategies.   Key Responsibilities   Reporting & Analytics   Data Management: Gather, cleanse, and validate data from ERP, CRM, and operational systems to ensure data accuracy and reliability.   Executive Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards and reports in Sigma, Power BI, and Excel to track business performance, highlight risks, and enable decision-making.   Insights & Trends : Apply descriptive and inferential statistical analysis to identify performance drivers, customer trends, and improvement opportunities.   KPI Development : Define and monitor key operational and customer value metrics to track progress against strategic objectives.     MBR & Steering Committee Reporting : Develop performance updates, executive narratives, and visualizations for monthly business reviews and steering committees.   Customer Value Enablement Support   Process & Performance Analysis : Partner with Product Operations teams (Content, Research, Automation, Offshore) to assess workflows, identify gaps, and recommend data-driven improvements.   Voice of the Customer : Translate operational data into insights that reflect customer impact and support strategic prioritization.   Cross-Functional Alignment: Provide analytics and reporting that help drive accountability and alignment across Product, Customer Care, and Solution Delivery.   Qualifications   Education :   Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field (MBA preferred but not required).   Experience :   5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst / Data Analyst in supply chain, healthcare, or a related industry.   Proven track record in reporting, dashboard development (preferably in Sigma), and KPI design.   Experience supporting executive-level reporting and operational performance reviews.   Prior exposure to automation analytics is a plus.   Technical Skills :   BI & Data Visualization: Strong skills in Sigma (preferred), Power BI, or Tableau.   SQL & Data Querying: Ability to extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets.   Excel Expertise: Advanced formulas, pivoting, and reporting.   Soft Skills :   Strong communication and storytelling skills to translate data into executive-ready insights.   Analytical problem-solver with a continuous improvement mindset.   Ability to operate effectively in a global, matrixed organization with minimal supervision.     Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities   Customer-Centric Mindset: Always connecting analytics to customer value and business outcomes.   Innovative Thinking : Ability to simplify complex data into clear recommendations.   Continuous Learning : Commitment to staying current on emerging technologies and best practices.   Leadership & Independence : Operates autonomously with minimal supervision while keeping stakeholders well-informed.   Certifications : CBIP, Lean Six Sigma, or other analytics/process certifications are a plus.        GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes. GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe - who rely on smart, secure healthcare-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions. It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce - not shift - the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. Together we take more than a billion dollars out of the cost of delivering healthcare every year. GHX is privately owned, operates in the United States, Canada and Europe, and employs more than 1000 people worldwide. Our corporate headquarters is in Colorado, with additional offices in Europe.
